source.geometry: Metro RLIS Streets (services2.arcgis.com/McQ0OlIABe29rJJy Streets FeatureServer layer 0), fetched 2026-11-13 for the box x 7604500-7615500, y 667500-677500 (EPSG:2913); every centreline within 500 ft of a mapped line is kept, cut into 20 ft pieces and merged back into runs of one type, plus three lines the figure draws where RLIS carries no street
source.how: The figure is a 1600 x 1061 px raster (no vectors). It was registered to the RLIS centrelines by chamfer matching: an affine transform fitted so the centrelines fall on the figure's white street pixels (mean distance 0.13 px over 25,602 samples; about 4.88 ft a pixel, north up). Each 20 ft piece of centreline was then typed by the figure's own colours beside it, within 11 px (about 54 ft) either side, ignoring lines that cross it: Type A (solid blue, RGB about 0 88 168) where 50% or more of the piece has it alongside, Type B (dotted light blue, about 56 136 200) where 30% or more does, doubt where a trace of either (12% A or 8% B) shows but not enough to type, none otherwise. The drawn lines sit along both block faces, so a typed run means the street; where the figure draws one side only the other side is typed too (the conservative reading). Areas C and D are tax lots named in 70.20.10.6.D.4 and are answered from the TLID, not traced (flats.geom.active_frontage).
